findings.issue: Button label #FFFFFF on #1A73E8 falls below WCAG AA for body text.
findings.user_impact: Users may struggle to read the call-to-action.
findings.recommendation: Increase button text contrast or darken the background.

findings.issue: Cards are separated by only 8px instead of 16px.
findings.user_impact: The layout feels cramped and harder to scan.

findings.issue: Footer items are not vertically aligned with the copyright text.
findings.recommendation: Align footer links with the baseline grid.

summary: Mock audit produced three actionable findings.
